patch_list: Stops advertising identifier and app set ID collection, install-referrer attribution, Google measurement and Firebase Analytics, and turns off Facebook's advertiser identifier and event upload. Play Games sign-in and cloud saves keep worki…
Blocks Beacon ad loading and showing using its own failure callbacks on the original UI-thread dispatch, skips bidder-token collection, and disables ad SDK initialization and startup providers.
Hides the paid Bird Coins tab and opens Power-ups instead. Power-ups and Slingshots remain available.

Declares Angry Birds Friends a parked game app, so Android Auto and car hosts like DriveDeck and Gearslip list it on the car screen by themselves. Android Auto still needs Unknown sources in its developer settings for a patched app.
